# Review packet P2-analytical-01

Priority P2, domain analytical, 14 items. Status of every item: not approved.

**How to review independently:** answer every item below before opening the answer sheet. Then compare, and mark each item ACCEPT / FIX (say what) / REJECT in `decisions.csv` (one row per id). Do not edit the item files; the bank worker applies fixes as draft replacements.

## Items

### 1. `CIVIO-ANA-SYLLOGISM-000053-R1`  (professional, medium, 45 s)

Statement 1: Some mangoes are exports. Statement 2: All mangoes are fruits. Which conclusion follows from both statements?

- (A) No fruits are exports.
- (B) Some fruits are exports.
- (C) All fruits are exports.
- (D) All exports are mangoes.

### 2. `CIVIO-ANA-SYLLOGISM-000643-R1`  (professional, medium, 45 s)

- (A) Some structures are landmarks.
- (B) All landmarks are bridges.
- (C) No structures are landmarks.
- (D) All structures are landmarks.

- (D) Some trained first responders are retired soldiers.

### 12. `CIVIO-D1022-ANA-0059`  (professional, medium, 60 s)

- (C) No holders of a professional license are public-school teachers.
- (D) All listed with the PRC are public-school teachers.

### 14. `CIVIO-D1022-ANA-0061`  (professional, medium, 60 s)

## Answer sheet (open only after answering)

### 1. `CIVIO-ANA-SYLLOGISM-000053-R1`: key (B) Some fruits are exports.

- Why correct: "Some fruits are exports." is right. It follows from the two statements with no extra facts.
- (A) This contradicts the statements: the mangoes that are exports are also fruits.
- (C) Only some of the mangoes are exports, so we cannot say all fruits are.
- (D) This flips the statement about exports. Some exports may be outside the group.
